intro: Explosive Consultation is an Alliance assignment originating in Westfall to combat toxic industrial operations hidden deep within the Deadmines. Following discoveries that point to heavy machinery poisoning local farmland, adventurers are dispatched to the Dwarven District of Stormwind to enlist an engineering specialist capable of supplying heavy explosives.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.
Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
